nodes.label: Area Icon (Map Pin with Location Marker)
nodes.author: Fonticons, Inc.
nodes.description: Font Awesome Free v7.0.1 SVG icon depicting a map location pin combined with a geographic area/boundary concept. The icon shows a folded map with a location pin overlay, rendered in a 640x640 viewBox. Used in the feuerwehren extension to represent organizational area units (KBR/KBI/KBM districts) in the fire department management system.
